channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rodney McGruder | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rodney McGruder from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Stewart on Rodney McGruder coming back:

“That's someone I talk to every day. He's my back, for sure. His presence here on the team, I felt that every day. To have him back, it's definitely going to be good.”

Isaiah Stewart on Rodney McGruder, Jan 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Cory Joseph, Rodney McGruder
item.description:
#Pistons Isaiah Stewart on Rodney McGruder's (and Cory Joseph's) veteran experience:

“They've been in games and certain situations and they've seen a lot of things we haven't seen.”

Isaiah Stewart on Cory Joseph, Rodney McGruder, Jan 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Rex Kalamian on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
#Pistons acting coachRex Kalamian on Rodney McGruder:

“This is the third time I've coached his (OKC, LAC and DET) and he is the ultimate professional. Just a classy guy, hard worker and team-first person, and a great individual.”

Rex Kalamian on Rodney McGruder, Jan 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Rodney McGruder:

“Rodney has always stayed ready. He did it for the Clippers and he did it for us... it's good to have a Rodney McGruder on your team.”

Dwane Casey on Rodney McGruder, Dec 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Rodney McGruder:

“It's huge...he's a true professional; he came in and he changed things a little bit and go us going... he embraces that role.”

Dwane Casey on Rodney McGruder, Nov 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on why he played Rodney McGruder at point guard on Tuesday:

“His basketball intellect. He’s one of the smarter players on our team. I knew he could play point guard. (Utah's) defensive toughness, it’s tough to put a young point guard out there.”

Dwane Casey on Rodney McGruder, Feb 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Draymond Green on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Draymond Green on the kerfuffle after the game:

“When the f--- Rodney McGruder become a tough guy? Everybody in the league tough these days. It's crazy. I've seen a lot of tough guys this year. ... But I know nobody is scared of Rodney McGruder. Are you kidding me?”

Draymond Green on Rodney McGruder, Jan 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Wayne Ellington on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Wayne Ellington on the Warriors' comments last night:

“First of all, I think it's very unprofessional and definitely not classy for someone to attack Rodney's career ... he's one of the most hardworking and humble, down to earth guys we have in this league.”

Wayne Ellington on Rodney McGruder, Jan 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Jovan Buha:Doc Rivers on Rodney McGruder’s status:

“I don’t think he’s close to returning. He may be out there shooting, but I don’t think he’s close.”

Doc Rivers on Rodney McGruder, Dec 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Moe Harkless, Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Thibodeau said of the team’s defensive depth.

“You can’t overlook guys like Harkless and McGruder because you can throw those guys in and have them guard a primary scorer for 7-10 minutes. You can give them a lot of different looks. I think the great players in this league, over time, they’ll figure out one defender. “But if you throw different looks at them and put different guys at different times — it’ll also free those guys up offensively. That’s where the great value in having that type of lineup lies.”

Tom Thibodeau on Moe Harkless, Rodney McGruder, Jul 7, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Spoelstra on McGruder's left knee soreness:

“It was bothering him a little bit the last few days,and we just want to take care of it.”

Erik Spoelstra on Rodney McGruder, Mar 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Wesley Iwundu on Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Iwundu said Spo asked him in meeting

“If I drop a ball under the table who gets it first -- you or Rodney McGruder?”

Wesley Iwundu on Rodney McGruder, May 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.
